_provenance.capture_command: python -m email_to_bom.cli [--json] [--component-ids ...] <input>  (run from the source repo root, its own .venv, Python 3.14.6)
_provenance.runtime_deps_at_capture: none - the source declares dependencies = [] and is stdlib-only; pytest>=7.0 is dev-only and not needed to run the engine
_provenance.normalization: NONE. Every fixture declares an empty normalize block. The engine has no clock, no randomness, no run-ids and emits no absolute paths on the CLI path; byte-identical output was confirmed across repeated runs and across PYTHONHASHSEED values. Nothing is masked, so parity cannot be silently loosened.
_provenance.fixture_inputs: plain-steam / quoted-printable / multipart-html are the source's own test fixtures, copied verbatim (already anonymised: .example domains, 'Acme Dairy'). suction-assembly / confirmed-ids / human-render derive from the source's examples/sample_rfq.eml with the IDENTITY LINES ANONYMISED (real sender name, address and end-customer replaced); the technical content is unchanged, and the expected outputs were captured from the source engine running on these anonymised inputs, so parity remains a real capture.
_provenance.round_25_changes: Fixture inputs moved to the RFC 2606 reserved .example TLD (round 25, F-7) and the affected expected outputs were re-captured from the source engine. Added the confirmed-ids-render fixture: the FLAGGED render path, which is the one combination no fixture covered and where round 25 found F-1 (flags dropped between phases, so the human draft contradicted the CaseState).
_provenance.source_commit_note: All 7 expected outputs re-captured at this single commit in round 25. b15b23d changed only tests/property/shape_matrix.py, so the engine content is identical to b1f9950, which src/vendor/PROVENANCE.md stamps as the vendoring commit.
